blocks.heading: About me
blocks.body:
I'm a DevOps / DevSecOps engineer based in Delhi. I started as a trainee in July 2025 and now own security, compliance and cost work for one enterprise AWS organisation and the full DevOps lifecycle for another.

Outside work I run my own infrastructure entirely on free tiers — Terraform for five providers, self-hosted services on Oracle Cloud, and open-source tools like **Dohra**. Zero cost is a constraint, not an excuse: everything is infrastructure as code, version-controlled and documented.

I'm currently preparing for the **CKA**, followed by the **CKS**.
